answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 172599 Country: India Title: Should we recite Quran in the third rakah of Maghrib? Question: Should we recite Quran in the third rakah of Maghrib? Answer ID: 172599 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1242/1080/D=12/1440) A person offering salah alone and the Imam should read only Surah Fatiha in the third rakah of Maghrib. But if one is offering behind an imam then he should not read anything and stay silent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
